values.note: For 1-2 people, plus tax: Valley sites (30-amp, shared water, among tenters) $40 weekdays / $50 weekends; pull-throughs 8-19 and 46-57 (50-amp and water) $50 / $60. flags: Google Maps: 4.7 from 211 reviews (Freedom Valley Campgrounds, +1 419-929-8100, freedomvalleycamping.com).

CRITERIA - likely a men's / clothing-optional campground (cf. Cedar Hills WI, which AWH skipped as adults-only + clothing-optional, 2026-10-21): the About page says the campground 'invites men over 21 to join our diverse group of Seasonals', and the rules say 'No public sex. Absolutely no nudity in non-designated areas (in plain sight of the road and office)', i.e. designated nude areas exist. The 'Family campground' wording in our note is ours, not the park's. AWH call.

CRITERIA test 2 (membership): every guest pays a '$15 season membership ... added to the first booking or visit of each season'. With it a single weekday night in the cheapest RV site is $55 before tax and a weekend night $65 (+$5 pp on holidays); no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: none; Cleveland 80 km); not a Good Sam park. Under the mandatory-fee rule this may fail the $50 gate on a one-night stay.
Booking is a request form answered by the office, not an instant booking; requests were 'closed for the season' on 2026-10-30.

Waterfront re-audit lead (not changed): the park says it sits 'on 120 acres of woods along the Vermilion River', and its map puts primitive camping 'toward the river' and the Eagles Nest (sites 97-107) 'on a loop near the river'. Stored 'not waterfront' may be right for the RV sites; worth a look at the Eagles Nest loop.
Pin fine: the park's GPS N 41°05.275' W 82°28.578' (41.08792,-82.47630) is ~150 m from the stored pin.
